newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta sets pre-hearing meeting on Syncrude mine.
newsitem.headline: Alberta sets pre-hearing meeting on Syncrude mine.

text.p: The Alberta Energy and Utilities Board, the province's energy regulator, said on Wednesday it scheduled a pre-hearing meeting on Syncrude Canada Ltd 's application to develop its Aurora oil sands mine in northern Alberta.

Syncrude has applied to start developing the project, which would consist of two separate oil sands mines and pipelines to transport the bitumen to its extraction plant at Mildred lake. Aurora is located about 70 km north of Fort McMurray.

The AEUB said the pre-hearing meeting would be held to discuss the timing and location of the hearing, the issue of cooperative development in the region, potential interventions and the need for additional information.
The meeting was set for April 2 in Fort McMurray.

Syncrude's partners include Imperial Oil Ltd, Petro-Canada, Gulf Canada Resources Ltd, Athabasca Oil Sands Investments Inc, Canadian Oil Sands Investments Inc, Alberta Energy Co Ltd, Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd, Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd unit Mocal Energy Ltd and Murphy Oil Corp.
